description: Controlled optional strategicRole target values for future hint normalization. Existing hints are not required to carry strategicRole in AI003.

lineSupportPolicy.requiredForFutureLineSupport: A future non-legacy lineSupport strategy anchor should normally carry at least one compatible strategicRole.

strategicRoles.description: A card directly turns a strategy into score, access, damage, tags, or another payoff.
A card provides repeatable or central machinery that makes a strategy work.
A card enables a payoff or engine but is not itself the payoff.
A card supplies necessary support such as economy, draw, memory, or coverage.
A card provides flexible tactical value without being a strategy anchor.
A card protects against pressure, damage, tags, traces, or access.
A card primarily rescues a bad or urgent board state.
A card can directly close or materially define the win path.
A card taxes credits, clicks, runs, accesses, or resources.
A card punishes a visible condition such as tags, access, or low grip.
A card directly improves agenda scoring, score windows, or remote scoring conversion.
